description.purpose: Committee and subcommittee seats across published Congresses
description.usage: Explore member assignments to congressional committees and subcommittees for the Congresses included in the retained source snapshot.

schema.name: rosters
schema.businessName: Committee and subcommittee seats across published Congresses
schema.dataGranularityDescription: One member assignment to a committee or subcommittee in a Congress (keyed by congress, system_code, bioguide_id; only Congresses populated in the pinned upstream committee_assignments snapshot appear; congress_basis and edition_date say which source and date state it)
schema.description: Explore member assignments to congressional committees and subcommittees for the Congresses included in the retained source snapshot.

properties.name: congress
properties.description: Congress number for the committee assignment

customProperties.value: Keyed by (congress, system_code, bioguide_id); populated from the pinned upstream committee_assignments snapshot, whose populated Congresses the coverage congress_start and congress_end bound. Earlier Congresses appear only after an upstream backfill is pinned.

properties.name: system_code

customProperties.value: hsba00-tf-terrorism-financing is directory-defined: that House Financial Services task force has no Congress.gov code; its committees row is synthesized with parent hsba00.

properties.description: Lowercase committee or subcommittee system code

properties.name: title

customProperties.value: Chamber-file titles are verbatim (Chairman, Ranking Member); directory titles are normalized (Chair, Vice Chair, Ranking Member).

properties.description: Committee leadership or seat position title

properties.name: rank
properties.description: Numeric party rank on the committee when printed by the source

properties.name: party

customProperties.value: Preserves the supplied assignment party; missing or blank values stay null. Service-term party assertions do not establish party or caucus at a roster observation, and the input does not supply qualified dated affiliation history.

properties.description: Party caucus for the committee assignment

properties.name: congress_basis

customProperties.value: Earlier Congresses' seats come from one Congressional Directory edition per Congress (directory). A Congress whose edition serves no committee granules takes each committee from Internet Archive captures of the House file (file) and the Senate file (caller) when present, and falls back to a reviewed reading of the edition's PDF (directory-manual) for committees and subcommittees absent from those files. The current Congress comes from the current chamber files.

properties.description: Where the seat's Congress comes from: file (the House roster file states it), caller (the Senate file states none), directory (a Congressional Directory edition's package metadata) or directory-manual (a reviewed one-off reading of an edition's PDF)

properties.name: edition_date
properties.description: Snapshot date the roster describes: a directory edition's dateIssued, or an archived chamber file's Internet Archive capture date

properties.name: source_granule
properties.description: The GovInfo directory granule (or, for a manual reading, package; for an archived chamber file, its Internet Archive URL) that states the seat

properties.name: source_line
properties.description: The granule text line where the printed entry starts; for a manual reading, PDF page:line

properties.name: position_basis
properties.description: For a directory seat with a title: printed, or inferred for a Ranking Member taken from print position (the first minority-column entry)

properties.name: printed_entry
properties.description: For a directory seat, the entry as printed (name and state), kept when a value was corrected

properties.name: entry_label
properties.description: For a directory seat: corrected (a printed name, state or column was corrected; printed_entry keeps it), after_departure (printed after the member left) or no_congress_gov_code (the body has no Congress.gov code)

customProperties.value: Nullability transcribes the phase-2 annex §3 file table (docs/plans/phase-2-annex-20261028.md): a type without "nullable" there is required.

value: Committee seats cover only the Congresses populated in the pinned upstream committee_assignments snapshot; congress_start and congress_end bound the published Congresses, and any Congress without roster rows, including every Congress when both are null, is unavailable, not zero seats

A seat from a Congressional Directory edition (congress_basis directory or directory-manual) is one dated printed snapshot (edition_date): changes during that Congress are invisible, ex officio members appear only where printed, and a list printed after a member left keeps that member (entry_label after_departure)
A Ranking Member with position_basis inferred is the first minority-column entry of a list printing no minority leader, not a stated title
Printed directory entries that are not seats (vacancies, party organizations, unread lines) are not in this release; they are SpicyRegs committee_directory_entries rows

value.meaning: Committee or subcommittee assignment for the roster row's Congress.
value.scope: rosters.congress (Congresses populated in the pinned committee_assignments snapshot)

value.meaning: Assigned member for the roster row's Congress.
value.scope: rosters.congress (Congresses populated in the pinned committee_assignments snapshot)
